texts.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
texts.en:
As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a perfect sphere.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond. It simply sits at the edge of the abyss. Waiting.

texts.zh:
当[Root.GetName]进入一个新的恒星系时，他们看到了令人震惊的现象。一个巨大的金属球体在宇宙中盘旋。它的表面上没有任何推进器或是别的什么机械部件推着它前进。但它就是在移动。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。
texts.en:
As the [Root.GetName] enters a new system, it is greeted by an awe-inspiring sight. A gigantic metallic orb, hovering through space. No thrusters, nor any mechanical parts outside of its shell seem to push it through the void. It simply moves.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond.

texts.zh:
您好，星际旅行者，我们是策展人。

我们遵从的古训自万古之前便由星系中的支配力量所制定。我们献身于保存世间所有的知识，来避免星系再次陷入荒蛮与死寂的黑暗时期。

但我们失败了。

我们只留下了很少的幸存者，但相比我们的前辈，我们完成自己神圣使命的决心丝毫没有动摇。我们有意与你分享一些我们的知识……当然，这不是无偿的。
texts.en:
Greetings, star travelers. We are the Curators.

Our ancient order was established eons ago by the various galactic powers in ascendancy at the time. We were dedicated towards the preservation of all knowledge, in an effort to safeguard the galaxy from descending into yet another dark age of mass extinctions and barbarism.

We failed.

Few of us remain today, but we are no less committed to our sacred mission than our predecessors were. We are willing to share some of our knowledge with you... for a price.

texts.zh: 幸会，宇宙中的探险家。与你进行通话的是[curator_enclave_country.GetName]。也许你已经知晓我们古训中的信条。和其他城邦中的策展人同行们一样，只要你们能满足我们的要求，我们便愿意同你们交易。
texts.en: Well met, explorers. You are speaking to the [curator_enclave_country.GetName]. Perhaps you are already familiar with the tenets of our ancient order. Like our esteemed colleagues in the other Curator enclaves, we are willing to trade provided that you can meet our rates.

texts.zh: 也许你正在疑惑我身后壁画上图案的意义。这是个好问题，答案也会十分有趣。只需要1.5亿亿能量币你便可以得到这个问题的解答。
texts.en: Perhaps you are wondering about the significance of the shapes you see on the mural behind me. That is a good question with a very interesting answer! The fee for this information is 15 quadrillion energy credits.

texts.zh: 我们是策展人，欢迎你们，请问你们需要什么服务？
texts.en: You have reached the Curators. How may we assist you?

texts.zh: 你们知不知道这次对话正在被七个来自不同领域的亚空间实体所密切地监听着？唉，想和他们交流是不可能的，因为你们的文明远不具备能与他们交流的通讯技术。
texts.en: Did you know that this conversation is being closely monitored by entities from seven different subspace realms? Alas, I fear that the technology to communicate with them is too far beyond the present capabilities of your civilization to do you any good.

texts.zh: 不用担心，我们已经更新了档案系统，[Root.GetName]的信息已经被记入了档案以供后辈们查阅。即使在你的帝国经历不可避免的消亡后，你们仍将在档案中被铭记。
texts.en: Fear not. We have updated our archives with information about the [Root.GetName] for future generations. You will be remembered long after the inevitable collapse of your star nation.

texts.zh: 我想告诉你的东西有很多，但我不能白白免费地告诉你。这个空间站需要很多能源来维持运转…我们必须考虑收支的平衡。
texts.en: There is so much I wish I could tell you, but I simply can't do it for free. This space station requires a lot of energy to operate... we must consider our overhead.

texts.zh: 谨代表策展人协会向您问候，请问您有什么需要的吗？
texts.en: Greetings on behalf of the Curator order. Was there something you wanted?

texts.zh: 我们一向很高兴能和你们的政府进行贸易，我们这里还有一些科技资源，你们有兴趣吗？
texts.en: As always, it is a pleasure doing business with your government. Can we interest you in some technology?

texts.zh: 很高兴见到你。我很肯定今天我们可以达成一些互利互惠的协定。
texts.en: It is good to see you. I am sure we can come to some sort of mutually beneficial agreement before this day is over.

texts.zh: 知识一旦落入了恶毒之徒的手中，就会变得相当危险。但我们能怎么办呢？毕竟我们需要能源才能运营下去……
texts.en: Knowledge in the wrong gripping appendages can be dangerous, but what can we do? We need energy to keep the lights on...

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们不知道的事情还有很多。求求你……让我们教授你们更多有关这个宇宙的知识吧。
texts.en: There is much that you do not yet know, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Please... let us educate you about the universe.

texts.zh: 我们持有整个星系的详细星图，这是从上百种不同的物种处收集来的信息的汇总。也许这能提起你们的兴趣？
texts.en: We possess detailed star charts of the entire galaxy, gathered by explorers from a hundred different races. Perhaps they would be of interest to you?

texts.en: Knowledge is everything. It must be preserved.

自不用说，我们要为这样的服务收取一定的报酬。不过我认为你一定会感觉我们的价格十分实惠。
texts.en:
Of course. We are prepared to offer you limited access to our extensive databanks for a period of ten standard years. This should provide a significant boost to the research efforts of your planetside Research Labs.

We will require compensation for this service, naturally, but I think you'll find that our prices are very reasonable.

Ah yes, the chromatic being from long ago. We have studied it for as long as our order has existed. As have several civilizations before us.

This machine is beyond ancient. For all we know, it has always been. And yet, all it does is orbit that black hole. It's fascinating to us, but we understand if it is too much for you to grasp.

We believe it is the progeny of an extragalactic predator of unthinkable proportions: one that stalks the void of space in search of its prey. Though we have never before encountered a live specimen, we have heard tales of the destruction and chaos grown Voidspawn leave in their wake. It is said that worlds fester under their shadow.

texts.en:
Ah, the scrap bot. The Scavenger is a curious construct from a lost age. Endlessly it searches through the debris fields of the galaxy, welding the guns, engines, and materials scavenged from countless derelicts onto its own hull. Its mass and firepower have been increasing in such a fashion for centuries, with no sign of relenting.

No-one knows if there is an upper limit to how massive it could become, given enough time and scrap to work with.

texts.en: The Toxic Entity is an elusive being. It has roamed the galaxy for millennia, occasionally choosing to spurt venom at worlds in what we can only imagine is a natural stage of its life cycle. We have heard that it has been tracked to the [toxic_god_system.GetName] system.

texts.en:
The Toxic Entity is an elusive being. It has roamed the galaxy for millennia, occasionally choosing to spurt venom at worlds in what we can only imagine is a natural stage of its life cycle. But you already knew this, of course!

We are sorry, but we cannot help you find its present whereabouts - it has not been spotted by any of our contacts for quite some time.

texts.zh: 那个颇为神经质的自动化机械体来到这个星系的时间并不长，但不要被这种新奇所迷惑。奥普斯哨兵的创造者们在被一台专横的机器同化之前，就已经是他们所在领域中最杰出的工程师之一。我们不知道自那时起，那个机器意识遭遇了怎样严酷的命运，但从哨兵那痛苦的扭动来看：情况似乎相当不稳定。如果你决定满足自己的好奇心，务必小心行事。
texts.en: That rather twitchy automaton is a relative newcomer to the galaxy, but don't be fooled by such novelty. The Opus Sentinel's creators were counted among the finest engineers in their sector even before they were assimilated by a tyrannical machine. We do not know what harsh fate has befallen the machine consciousness since then, but if the Sentinel's agonized writhing is anything to go by: the whole situation appears quite volatile. Tread carefully, should you decide to slake your curiosity.

texts.zh:
恕我冒昧，但我以为您会比我们更了解此事！与我们所研究的对象相比，那个颇为不安的自动化机械体是个新面孔，但作为对手同样令人畏惧。

我们知道，即便在被同化之前，奥普斯哨兵背后的工程师们也被认为是该领域最优秀的人才。因此，那艘战舰不容小觑。我们不太清楚的是，这艘船是如何与[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]如此疏远的。从“哨兵”痛苦的扭动来看，我们推测情况仍然相当不稳定。您是否同意这一评估，[root.GetSpeciesName]？
texts.en:
Forgive my impertinence, but I assumed you would know more about it than we do! That rather twitchy automaton is a newcomer compared to what we usually study here, but is no less fearsome an opponent.

We know that even before they were assimilated, the engineers behind the Opus Sentinel were counted among the finest in their sector. That warship is therefore not to be underestimated. What is less clear to us is how the vessel became so detached from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. We gather from the Sentinel's agonized writhing that the whole situation remains quite volatile. Would you agree with assessment, [root.GetSpeciesName]?

当然，在做出人员安排之前，你必须准备好合适数量的……资金赞助。
texts.en:
We are willing to pledge the services of one of our most brilliant scientists to your cause. This is not an offer we make to just anyone, you understand!

A suitable... donation will of course be necessary, before traveling arrangements can be made.

texts.zh:

即使对我们来说，这也不是一件容易的事情。成本并非微不足道。但在所有商品中，知识仍是最宝贵的。
texts.en:
We are willing to infuse your collective with the fundamental principles of knowledge. A serious procedure, and one only available to a shared consciousness.

Even for us, it is no easy thing to achieve. The cost is not insignificant. But of all commodities, knowledge remains the most precious.

它们为何不同？它们通往哪里？我们决定不要对这些谜团太过深究——“一朝被蛇咬，零点一七年怕井绳”这道理你懂的——但我们愿意分享一些可能与其有关的近期发现。

当然，不是免费的。
texts.en:
The L-Gates? Yes, like the other Gateways they predate even the oldest Stagnant Ascendancy, but we are sure you have figured that out already.

Why are they different? Where do they lead? We have opted not to delve too deeply into those particular mysteries - "thrice bitten, zero-point-seventeen shy" you know how it is - but we are willing to share some recent revelations that just might be related.

For a price.

等等——别告诉我你就是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？真是万分抱歉……我一定是把你跟……[unfriends.GetName]搞混了？

跟你讲，只要你告诉我们一件我们还不知道的，关于无限球体的事，我们就会慷慨地奖励你。
texts.en:
YOU!? Uncover the Infinity Machine's secret?! That is about as likely as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to survive into the next century. Not very likely, if that was unclear.

Wait - don't tell me YOU are the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? My sincerest apologies... I must have confused you with the... [unfriends.GetName]?

Tell you what: give us one thing we do not yet know about the Infinity Sphere and we will reward you handsomely.

texts.zh: 在[curator_system.GetName]星系摧毁了策展人的空间站之后，我们能干的军队在策展人曾经占据的区域搜寻任何有价值的东西。他们成功恢复了一下策展人数据库的内存碎片，这将能极大地促进我们的研究。
texts.en: After destroying the ancient Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system, our capable forces combed the area it once occupied for anything valuable. They managed to recover several memory fragments from the Curator databanks that should be a great boon to our research.

texts.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

残余离子轨迹表明，这次袭击是[curator_destroyer.GetName]所为。
texts.en:
Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space station has been destroyed.

Residual ion trails suggest that forces from the [curator_destroyer.GetName] were behind this attack.

texts.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

发动此次袭击的势力尚不明确。
texts.en:
Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space station has been destroyed.

The forces responsible for this attack remain unidentified.

texts.zh:
与[From.GetName]的一切联络均已中断。经过侦测，确认古老的策展人空间站已被摧毁。 这些报告表明进攻势力隶属于[curator_destroyer.GetName]。

不幸的是，策展人势力的消弭也意味着我们再也没办法使用他们庞大的数据库了。
texts.en:
All contact has been lost with the [From.GetName], and our recon assets have confirmed that the ancient Curator station was destroyed. These reports suggest the attack force belonged to the [curator_destroyer.GetName].

Unfortunately, the demise of the Curators means we have also lost access to their extensive databanks.

texts.zh:

不幸的是，策展人势力的消弭也意味着我们再也没办法使用他们庞大的数据库了。
texts.en:
All contact has been lost with the [From.GetName], and our recon assets have confirmed that the ancient Curator station was destroyed. The forces responsible for this attack remain unidentified.

Unfortunately, the demise of the Curators means we have also lost access to their extensive databanks.

label.zh: 他们的遗产真的是可惜了。
label.en: A sad end to their legacy.

texts.zh:
看来我们真是高估你们了，你们的人根本不具备文明处事的能力。真是奇怪……我们通常在刚见面的时候就可以准确识别出某个物种是否具备好斗倾向。为什么对你们看走眼了呢。

我们已经剥夺了你们对我们数据库的访问权限。
texts.en:
It would appear that we grossly overestimated your capacity to act as a civilized nation. Strange... We are usually able to identify the violent ones at an early stage.

We have severed your access to our databanks, of course.

texts.zh: 你们这群笨蛋！袭击我们就等于放弃了知识，你们的后辈们将活在低科技水平的蛮荒之中！
texts.en: You fool! By attacking us, you are condemning future generations to lives of low-tech misery!

texts.zh: 你们受本能驱使而袭击我们，而现在你们要为此付出代价。我们将永远不再与[Root.GetName]分享我们的知识。
texts.en: Your base instincts compelled you to attack us, and now you must pay the price. We will never share our knowledge with the [Root.GetName] again.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们慷慨相助，你们却不识好人心。一群野蛮的渣滓！
texts.en: We had so much to offer you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and yet you would throw it all away. Neo-barbarian scum!

texts.zh: 你们已经成为整个策展人组织的敌人。
texts.en: You have been declared an enemy of the entire Curator Order.

texts.zh: 我们在无限神机上的登陆作战很成功。在我们的部队撤退后球体发生了爆炸，残骸飘进了质量巨大的黑洞。
texts.en: Our boarding attack on the Infinity Machine was successful. The sphere explodes as our team exits and the remains are starting to drift into the super massive black hole.

texts.zh: 无限神机被摧毁了。我们的飞船最终凭强大的火力摧毁了它的防御机能，而它的零件正在慢慢飘向质量巨大的黑洞。在爆炸之前它没有尝试过与我们取得联系。
texts.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed. Our ships finally managed to out-gun its defensive capabilities, and its components are now slowly drifting into the super massive black hole. It made no attempt to contact us before it exploded.

texts.zh:
当围绕那黑色深渊的机械球体被我们的武器击碎时，一缕微弱的信号穿过恒星系飘进星际间的黑暗虚空。它是一组加密的数据，复杂到需要我们的机器花上百万年的时间来破译。过了一会儿信号就消失了。

除此之外什么都没发生。球体的残骸静静飘着。扫描显示这可能是某种由大量独立单元互相连接而成的人工智能。它的外壳可供我们拆卸研究。
texts.en:
As the machine sphere orbiting the gaping abyss crumbles and falls to our weapons, a silent signal zooms through the system into the dark void between stars. It is encrypted data, so complex it would take our machines a million years to decipher. A moment later it is gone.

Nothing else happens. The sphere is silent and broken. Scans show that it probably was some sort of artificial intelligence built from a vast amount of individual units connected together. The husk has been left for our prying hands.

label.en: Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.

texts.zh: 无限神机被第三方势力摧毁了。它再也不能帮到我们的研究了！
texts.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed by some third party. It cannot help us in our research anymore!

texts.zh:
我们捕获到了一个信号。它源自于我们早先遭遇过的巨型金属球体。之前我们与之接触的尝试没有得到回应，而现在它正向它所环绕的黑洞发送有节奏的无线电波。

它正在做的事情让我方人员摸不着头脑，但它发送的信号可能成为科学家研究该球体的突破口。
texts.en:
We picked up a signal. It originates from the titanic metallic sphere we encountered earlier. Previously impervious to contact attempts, it now sends out a rhythmic pulse of radio waves, pointed towards the black hole it orbits.

What it's doing is beyond any of our staff, but this signal might have created an opening into the sphere for our scientists to exploit.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.zh:
金属球体已经被打开了。我们的骇客小队能够通过它的对外传输信号作为大门连接进球体的一个辅助处理器。我们正在从中接收数据，并且数据显示它在很长时间内都在扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。

它很古老。非常古老。

现在我们理解了这台永恒的计算机。如果我们再进一步，我们就有可能知道它在做什么，以及是谁建造了它。

它还隐藏着什么秘密呢？
texts.en:
The metallic orb has been opened up. Our hacking team has been able to use the outgoing signal as a gateway into one of the auxiliary CPUs of the sphere. We are receiving some data from it and can tell that it's been scanning the black hole Gargantua for a very long time.

It is old. Very old.

This constant calculator now lies within our grasp of understanding. If we push harder we might find out what it is doing here, and who built it.

What marvels might it contain?

label.en: Declare the sphere a divine instrument

label.zh: 骇入主硬盘并取走所有数据。
label.en: Hack the main hard drive and take everything.

label.zh: 这里面总会有自毁开关的，找到它。
label.en: There's always a self-destruct switch. Find it.

label.zh: 我们必须从这个东西中获取知识。
label.en: We must absorb the knowledge of this entity.

texts.zh: 我们成功地入侵了球体的主硬盘。当我们开始接收数据时它启动了自毁序列。显然这是个避免数据被公之于众的自我防卫机制。在它自爆前我们成功地下载了大量数据，其中一些数据包含它的主中央处理器架构的技术规范。这对于我们的科研有极大的帮助。
texts.en: We successfully hacked into the technosphere's main hard drive. As we started retrieving data the metallic orb initiated a self-destruct sequence. Surely a self-defense mechanism to prevent it from sharing what it contains with the universe. Before it exploded we were successful in downloading a large amount of data, some of it containing technical specifications for its main CPU structure. This could help our researchers immensely.

texts.zh: 我们的数据挖掘单位已经成功攻破了这个人造球体主硬盘的内层。开始下载数据时，球体似乎启动了某种形式的自我终止序列，最终导致了它的毁灭。下载被迫中断了，但在此之前我们已经获得了大量技术数据，这将大大有助于我们的研究工作。
texts.en: Our data mining units have succeeded in breaching the inner layers of the technosphere's main hard drive. As the data download began, the orb entity initiated some manner of self-termination sequence that ultimately ended in its destruction. The download was aborted, but not before we were able to acquire vast amounts of technical data that will greatly benefit our research efforts.

texts.zh: 请不要尝试进入我们的记忆体。谢谢你们，再见了，小家伙们。
texts.en: Please refrain from trying to access our memories. Thank you and goodbye, little ones.

texts.zh: 你好，你好。很高兴见到你。
texts.en: Hello, hello. Nice to meet you.

texts.zh:
度过一段寒暄的时光总是让人十分愉快，不是吗？我们希望你们剩下的那些人不要再像之前那样无礼了。你看，我们从来不能享受聊天的时光。很少有人对量子计算中的精妙之处足够博学，因而也很少有人能理解我们。所以，谢谢你们。

我们是无限神机。你们如此称呼我们，尽管这并非我们本来的名字。或许你们还没有想出这个名字？无论如何，最终的结果会是这样的，请相信我们。
texts.en:
It is quite enjoyable to pass the time with pleasantries, is it not? We hope the rest of your kind is not like you were when you did not take kindly to small talk. You see, we don't get to enjoy conversation much anymore. Few are well-versed enough in the finer points of quantum programming to reach us. So thank you.

We are the Infinity Machine. Your words, not ours. Or has that not happened yet? Either way, it will eventually, trust us.

label.zh: 我们希望知道你们在这里的意图。
label.en: We wish to know your purpose here.

label.zh: 我们能帮你们进行研究吗？
label.en: Can we assist in your research?

label.zh: 极端平等主义 · 平等主义

texts.zh:
啊，好吧……嗯，也许吧。

借用你们最先进的处理器和最优秀的头脑可以为我们完成运算7.51×10^-9%的部分。我们乐于看到更快完成计算。我们想要知道答案。
texts.en:
Ah. Well... Hm. Perhaps.

We could finish about 7.51×10^-9% if we could borrow your most advanced processing unit as well as your brightest minds. We would be satisfied in finishing faster. We wish to know the answer.

label.zh: 我们会分配资源给你们。
label.en: We will allocate resources to you.

texts.zh:
我们不忍心看到你们用十分有限的生命来帮助我们。你们已经做了你们的那部分。你们的帮助很有用。现在也许宇宙不会在我们结束任务前到达热寂。任务仍然存在，我们会完成的。现在，这是你们的奖励：

你们是希望了解我们的秘密？还是希望解决你们自己的问题？
texts.en:
We cannot bear to see you spend more of your limited time helping us. You have done your part. You were very helpful. Maybe the heat death of the universe won't happen before we finish now. The task remains, and we shall finish it. Now, your reward:

Do you wish to learn one of our secrets? Or do you wish to solve your own problems?

label.zh: 我们希望知悉你们的一个秘密。
label.en: We wish to know one of your secrets.

label.zh: 我们希望知悉你们的一个秘密。
label.en: We wish to know one of your secrets.

label.zh: 我们希望凭自己来掌控未知。
label.en: We wish to master the unknown ourselves.

label.zh: 你们没什么能教给我们。
label.en: There is nothing you can teach us.

texts.zh:
成了。这事成了！

不知怎么地，我们解决了这个问题。你们帮上了忙。万物间联系的本质曾让我们困惑，而答案原来一直就隐藏在我们背后。当然了，谢谢你们，小东西。宇宙如此广阔，却又如此渺小。但如今我们终于有幸一睹其全貌。太美丽了。

既然我们已经计算出了无限，现在就只剩下一件事可做了。我们会向你们揭示真理。一路顺风，年轻人。
texts.en:
It is done. It is done!

Somehow we've solved it. You helped. The organic nature of things eluded us, the answer lied behind us all this time. Of course. Thank you, little ones. The universe is vast, yet so small. But now we see it all in its simple glory. It's lovely.

Now that we have calculated infinity, there is but one thing we can do now. We can show you the truth. Farewell, young ones.

texts.zh:
无限神机消失在了卡冈都亚黑洞中。然后……什么都没发生。它成功了吗？它尝试着要做什么？我们恐怕永远不会知晓了。它壳体上的一个微小残余物仍留在事件视界之外的漩涡中——我们或许能从中获取一些信息。

一份来自一位古怪朋友的最后的礼物。
texts.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua. And then... nothing happens. Did it succeed? What did it try to do? We may never know. A tiny residue of its hull remains within the vortex outside the event horizon - we might be able to learn some of its information from it.

A final gift from an odd friend.

texts.zh:
无限神机消失在它一直以来研究的卡冈都亚黑洞中。当它越过事件视界时，黑洞开始波动。黑洞吸收的光线开始减少，被它所吸引的物质的转速也开始变慢。转瞬间，它释放出了亮度足以超越任何恒星的光芒，并开始向宇宙喷发物质。

黑洞渐渐缩小，缩小到不能再称之为黑洞了，现在我们称之为“庞大古埃”，它周围的时间膨胀效应甚至变的更强。在庞大古埃之中能够看到一个镜像宇宙，就在黑洞的另一端，一个初生的宇宙。无限神机向我们揭示了真理。黑洞就是子宫，而宇宙就是其后代。

研究这个镜像宇宙一定会加深我们对当前生活的这个宇宙的理解。从另一个起点开始研究吧。
texts.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua, the thing it studied for so long. As it passes the event horizon, the black hole begins to fluctuate. It takes in less light and the swirls of matter being sucked into it slow down. In an instant it lets out more light than any sun and starts radiating matter back into the universe.

The black hole shrinks, unfitting of its name we now dub it "Pantagruel," causing time dilation to become even stronger around it. Within Pantagruel one can gaze into a mirror universe, the other end of the black hole, one just beginning. The Infinity Machine has shown us the truth. The black holes are wombs, and universes their offspring.

Studying this mirror universe is bound to teach us much about the one we live in. Learning from other beginnings.

texts.zh: 知道许多知识是策展人的本业。我们可以买到信息，但是要用他们的知识做些什么则取决于我们自己。
texts.en: It is the Curator's business to know things. We may buy information, but it is up to us to make something of their knowledge.

texts.zh: 一个不断发出神秘光线的金属球体正在环绕卡冈都亚黑洞。它现在毫无动静，但会一直保持毫无动静么？
texts.en: A glistening metal orb sits by the Gargantua Black Hole. It is silent for now, but will it be so forever?

texts.zh: 我们现在可以安全地研究环绕着卡冈都亚黑洞旋转的那个金属球体了。不知道在它的核心处能够发现些什么呢？
texts.en: The metallic orb hovering around the Gargantua black hole is now open for study. What will we find once we reach its processing center?

texts.zh:
我们需要辅助无限神机扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。虽说想要从黑洞中获取信息是不可能的，但是无限神机却似乎拥有某种查看黑洞的引力数据并回收这些数据的方法。只不过这个过程会非常耗时。

我们需要做的就是把运算能力借给它使用，以期稍微减短这段漫长过程。
texts.en:
In order to assist the Infinity Machine, we need to aid it in its scans of the black hole Gargantua. Receiving information from a black hole is impossible, but the Infinity Machine appears to have a method of accessing its gravitational data and getting information out of it. It simply takes a very long time.

We only need to lend it our processing power, easing its computational burden by a tiny fraction.

texts.zh: 骇入这个金属球体的核心程序也许能让我们进一步了解它到底是什么，以及它正在做什么事情。
texts.en: Hacking into the metallic sphere's central programming might yield some further insight into what it is and what it is doing.

texts.zh: 派一队拆除专家应该就可以发现这个神秘球形外壳的结构弱点，并借此终结这个无声的威胁。
texts.en: A team of demolitions experts should be able to identify and exploit points of failure in the integrity of the mysterious sphere's hull, ending the silent menace.
